quests.title: Bin Night, the El Alamein fountain
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. Somebody moves the bins on the El Alamein fountain in front of my drive every Easter Saturday night. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. Photograph the evidence and have a word; Kings Cross knows who. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: photograph the bins at the El Alamein fountain
and the woman who moved them

quests.title: The Macleay Street Sparky
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. The sparky off the Macleay Street job has owed me since the bathroom and drinks in Kings Cross from first thing. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. Forty will do and I'll write off the rest. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: find the sparky who owes for Macleay Street
and get forty of it

quests.title: Counting the Bourbon
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. Council says the the Bourbon car park is never full and I say it's full by eleven. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. Count both Kings Cross car parks, photograph whichever one makes me right. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: count the cars at the Bourbon
then the other car park
photograph the fuller one

quests.title: A Flat White From Harry's Cafe de Wheels
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. I want a flat white from the place near Harry's Cafe de Wheels, not the one next to it. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. Here by five, while it's still coffee and Kings Cross still has some. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: get a flat white from the cafe near Harry's Cafe de Wheels
and bring it back before it's lukewarm

quests.title: Lads Off Kellett Street
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. Three of them in TNs on the Kellett Street steps, flogging vapes to schoolkids at dawn. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Kings Cross used to move them on itself and now it rings me. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: move the lads on from Kellett Street

quests.title: Closing Time at Harry's Cafe de Wheels
quests.blurb: My knees are gone, so. Two blokes have slept in my doorway on Harry's Cafe de Wheels since the pub shut. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. The Kings Cross delivery's at eleven, so get them up and show me the step empty. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: walk the two drunks off Harry's Cafe de Wheels
and show me the doorway clear

then meet the ute at the far end

quests.title: Before They Touch the Wayside Chapel
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. They start on the Wayside Chapel on the last Sunday of the month and the orange fencing goes up. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. I want Kings Cross on record before it does. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: photograph the state of the Wayside Chapel
then the other end of it

quests.title: The Victoria Street Course
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. A bloke near Victoria Street runs a ninety-minute course he bills at four hundred, and I've paid. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. steps.label: do the course they run near Victoria Street
then show me what it taught you

quests.title: Meat Tray at Darlinghurst Road
quests.blurb: Right. Since you asked. The Darlinghurst Road raffle is thirty-five short of a meat tray and the draw is at half seven. I have rung the number on the letter four times. Find it in Kings Cross and put it in the tin. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: pick up two from near Darlinghurst Road
and get them here hot

quests.title: Trouble at Darlinghurst Road
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. Two lads and their mate decided at closing that Darlinghurst Road is theirs. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. The rest of Kings Cross disagrees, so explain the disagreement. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: sort the pair near Darlinghurst Road
and the mate who joined in
